radius_m.rationale: Bounded first probe; proximity proxy, not walked access.

screen.selection_rationale: Favor a lower recorded residential displacement burden while leaving commercial occupancy unresolved. This is a research preference, not a welfare ranking.

net_efficiency.rationale: Illustrative allowance for circulation and support space; not architectural design.

avg_net_unit_sf.rationale: Family oriented average size; no verified unit mix.

hard_cost_per_gsf.rationale: Stress-test input, not a Bronx contractor estimate.

soft_contingency_share.rationale: Illustrative combined allowance; excludes financing carry and site acquisition.

floor_height_ft.rationale: Concept diagram only; ground floor and actual structure unresolved.

opex_share_egi.rationale: Illustrative operating expense including assumed taxes; no verified tax program.

monthly_rent_test.rationale: Hypothetical all-unit collectible rents; not market rents or official AMI rents.

affordable_income_lens.rationale: Research objective only. Official household-size schedule, utility allowance and income bands remain unknown; not used to infer legal rent.

gross_per_zoning_sf.unit: gross sf per zoning area proxy sf
gross_per_zoning_sf.rationale: Simplification for probe arithmetic. Zoning floor area exemptions and actual gross building area conversion are unverified.

2028710002.disposition: Investigate current uses and leases before design
2028710002.rationale: Private ownership label and large area proxy justify a lead, but historical DOB filings describe a laundromat, medical signs and church/school/hall activity. PLUTO records retail use and E-442. Zero recorded homes does not imply an empty site. No new building rows observed in the exact-BBL queries; broader pipeline check remains unresolved. The E-designation source records hazardous-materials, air and noise requirements, including Phase I/II testing, HVAC fuel/stack limits and window attenuation or alternate ventilation; satisfaction status is not established.

2028430040.disposition: Exclude from ordinary private redevelopment shortlist
2028430040.rationale: PLUTO records Education Department ownership and a school building class. DOB filings describe PS64 school improvements, including filings in 2026. A public-facility co-location proposal would be a different mission and would require an agency-led service plan; unused FAR alone does not justify housing redevelopment.

2024890077.disposition: Exclude from ordinary private redevelopment shortlist
2024890077.rationale: PLUTO records Police Department ownership; DOB NOW filings describe underground gasoline storage tank replacement and associated excavation work. Housing use requires a public-service replacement or co-location decision and environmental diligence. PLUTO and DOB use different street addresses on the same BBL; preserve the alias rather than treating it as another lot.

lead_decision.rationale: Use the top private commercial parcel as an occupancy-first investigation lead. The other two tested parcels are recorded public facilities. This is not a recommendation to acquire or redevelop.
